description: This file defines the interface 'IController' within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It provides pure virtual functions for controlling plugins or modules, such as persisting state, deleting, rebooting, retrieving environment variables, configurations, and cloning callsigns.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for managing and controlling plugin instances in the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the plugin or module at the specified path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables for a given index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Sets configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign based on an existing one.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
